scope: Deterministic BuildKit and Compose workloads only; no host lane or complete 63-scenario fixture bundle.

provides: unlocked root account for public-key login

FIXTURE_IMAGE.pin: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> local image ID or repository@sha256:<64 lowercase hex>
FIXTURE_IMAGE.source: Build compose/Dockerfile with FIXTURE_BASE and capture immutable result ID.

FIXTURE_OWNER.source: Host harness retains exact project/environment/machine/run mapping.

FIXTURE_RUN.source: One unique candidate run token; same for all layer-cache comparison builds.

secret_scan_scope: exported BuildKit cache blobs after decompression
canaries.private_ssh_key_source: Generate a fresh isolated fixture key and agent outside source/build contexts; retain public key fingerprint only.

required_assertions: exact payload bytes
final image contains only payload.txt
intermediate canary absent from final stage
exact variant payload bytes
changed payload layer digest
first payload vertex executes
identical second build payload vertex cached
fresh isolated same-Machine builder without import misses
fresh isolated same-Machine builder with explicit import hits
sibling Machine and Environment without import miss
all payload bytes identical
layer_cache.notes: Cache-hit claims require raw BuildKit vertex receipts, not elapsed time or output digest alone.

cache_mount.notes: Use distinct owner tokens and forced-distinct step arguments. A fresh builder is required per candidate. Layer-cache export does not export cache-mount contents.

secrets.negative: Omit --secret; required mount must fail. Use a fresh builder or --no-cache so a cached vertex cannot hide a missing secret.

required_assertions: agent-only public-key authentication returns exact response
same server and known_hosts without --ssh fails
required mount missing fails before command
private key absent from image/cache/logs/evidence
host-key mismatch fails
ssh.notes: Pin the SSH client/server base, provision owned server public authorization and private host key, use strict known_hosts from that host key. No host ssh-agent or user keys.

required_assertions: created services not running before up
health event precedes dependent start event
blocked database prevents API and worker startup
direct worker-to-db and isolated paths denied by name AND actual inspected IP
API /value equals persisted database bytes
three distinct worker container IDs and matching /identity hostnames
scale down to one preserves surviving exact identity and removes the others
exec output streams and exit37 match
failure exit37 and partial resource inventory retained
stop/up does not rewrite persistence sentinel
down removes only exact project-owned resources
